description: Source code for DevToolsController and CDPConnection classes managing browser devtools interactions, including page/tab management, event handling, and communication with browser via CDP.

classes.name: DevToolsConnection
classes.description: Manages connection to browser devtools, handles tab/page operations, event emission, and communication with browser via CDP.

classes.name: CDPConnection
classes.description: Handles low-level Chrome DevTools Protocol session for a specific page, enabling command dispatch and event listening.

methods.name: on
methods.description: Registers an event listener for a specific devtools event.

methods.name: off
methods.description: Removes an event listener for a specific devtools event.

methods.name: _emit
methods.description: Emits an event to registered listeners and optionally sends it via sendEvent callback.

methods.name: onconnect
methods.description: Initializes connection to browser and sets up event listeners.

methods.name: _init
methods.description: Connects to browser, sets up context, and auto-selects first page.

methods.name: onclose
methods.description: Cleans up resources and closes browser connection.

methods.name: dispatch
methods.description: Dispatches a method call to the underlying browser or page.

methods.name: selectTab
methods.description: Selects a tab/page by pageId.

methods.name: closeTab
methods.description: Closes a tab/page by pageId.

methods.name: newTab
methods.description: Creates a new tab/page.

methods.name: navigate
methods.description: Navigates the selected page to a specified URL.

methods.name: back
methods.description: Navigates back in the selected page.

methods.name: forward
methods.description: Navigates forward in the selected page.

methods.name: reload
methods.description: Reloads the selected page.

methods.name: mousemove
methods.description: Simulates mouse move on the selected page.

methods.name: mousedown
methods.description: Simulates mouse down on the selected page.

methods.name: mouseup
methods.description: Simulates mouse up on the selected page.

methods.name: wheel
methods.description: Simulates mouse wheel event.

methods.name: keydown
methods.description: Simulates key down event.

methods.name: keyup
methods.description: Simulates key up event.

methods.name: _selectPage
methods.description: Handles logic for selecting a page, setting up event listeners.

methods.name: _deselectPage
methods.description: Handles cleanup when deselecting a page.

methods.name: pickLocator
methods.description: Initiates element locator picking.

methods.name: cancelPickLocator
methods.description: Cancels element locator picking.

methods.name: _sendCachedState
methods.description: Sends cached frame and tab list state.

methods.name: tabs
methods.description: Returns list of open tabs.

methods.name: _tabList
methods.description: Generates list of tab info objects.

methods.name: pageForId
methods.description: Finds a page by its pageId.

methods.name: _pageId
methods.description: Returns unique identifier for a page.

methods.name: _devtoolsUrl
methods.description: Constructs URL for devtools frontend.

methods.name: _pageInspectorUrl
methods.description: Constructs URL for inspecting a page.

methods.name: _sendTabList
methods.description: Emits the current list of tabs.

methods.name: _writeFrame
methods.description: Stores and emits a screencast frame.

methods.name: getBrowserRevision
methods.description: Retrieves browser revision string via CDP.

methods.name: dispatch
methods.description: Sends a command via CDP session.

methods.name: _initializeRawSession
methods.description: Creates a new CDP session for a page.
